checkpointKinds.expectedWalls: source-ink checkpoints that must remain classified as extruded wall geometry
checkpointKinds.expectedDetails: source-ink checkpoints that must remain flat door, stair or non-structural detail geometry
checkpointKinds.excludedAnnotations: dark source pixels from printed labels, dimensions or section markers that must not become geometry
checkpointKinds.expectedVoids: reviewed source-white openings or shaded non-architectural regions that must remain empty geometry
checkpointKinds.expectedRoomSpaces: reviewed room floor surface with scope=room containing its bound place anchor
checkpointKinds.selectionOnlyClosures: reviewed source-white doorway thresholds used only to isolate selectable faces; they must remain absent from wall/detail geometry
checkpointKinds.minimumBoundsSpan: guards against regression from the complete source floor to a cropped room group

auditorium.classificationReason: The current-state first-tier plan uses neutral mid-grey fills for structural perimeter and box pier or partition bodies, black linework for stage edges, box dividers and stairs, and a tonal gradient only to depict the stage surface. The two source channels preserve those semantics instead of extruding all dark raster ink.

apollinee.identityCrossCheck: Appendix 3 legacy Sala Malibran/Rubinstein/Guidi names are cross-identified as current Sala Sinopoli/Verdi/Dante on the 2023 measured plan, page 27 figure 23.

verticalLinkReview.reason: The two complete plans preserve stair geometry, but the reviewed sources do not label a shared shaft endpoint pair. The 2023 text also distinguishes closed west stairs from current north-wing access, so no cross-floor link is inferred.

routeBindingReview.reason: Figure 29 is explicitly the first box tier. The 2023 thesis states that its central axial bay is a large entrance and locates the imperial loggia on the second and third tiers; no reviewed upper-tier plan is available, so the guide stop is not assigned a false first-tier position.
